All from fact-check row 13.

caption:
Earth did not lose gravity for 7 seconds on 12 August 2026. The 'Project Anchor' posts cited a leaked '$89 billion NASA document' that no one has ever produced. Gravity is a property of mass; it has no off switch. NASA and fact-checkers debunked it. The real event that day was a total solar eclipse. Sources on slide 8. Images are generated illustrations.

#debunk #physics #gravity #science #factcheck

slides.body: The 'Project Anchor' hoax about 12 August 2026, and what physics says. Not a paper: NASA and fact-checker debunks, January and August 2026.
slides.alt: Cover: the black disc of a total solar eclipse with its white corona breaks the top right of a framed panel over Earth's limb at night; text: Debunk, Earth did not lose gravity.

slides.title: Gravity has no *off switch*
slides.body: The line plots no measurement. Gravity is a property of mass, and nothing in the claim could change Earth's mass. The eclipse began two hours after the claimed time. Axis not to scale.
slides.alt: Diagram on a dark field: a flat cyan line labelled Earth's gravity, 12 Aug over a day axis from 00:00 to 24:00 UTC, an amber tick at 14:33 UTC, the claim, and a cyan bracket for the eclipse, 16:58 to 18:34 UTC. Title: Gravity has no off switch.

slides.claim: NASA documents called Project Anchor ever produced
slides.body: NASA called it false; fact-checkers found no trace of it in NASA's records.
slides.alt: A dark Earth disc with a lit rim breaks the top left of the panel; a large amber 0 with the line NASA documents called Project Anchor ever produced.

slides.body: predicted a 7-second gravity loss at 14:33 UTC on 12 August 2026, blamed on "intersecting gravitational waves from colliding black holes". It spread across TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, X and Reddit.
slides.alt: A diamond-ring eclipse breaks the top right of the panel; the hoax's claim quoted: a leaked $89 billion NASA document predicted a 7-second gravity loss.

slides.claim: Gravity is a property of mass
slides.body: {{The myth: gravity can switch off for 7 seconds.}} It cannot be switched off. As long as Earth has mass, Earth has gravity. There is no off switch and no schedule. NASA spokesperson, January 2026: "Earth's gravity, or total gravitational force, is determined by its mass."
slides.alt: A dark Earth disc breaks the top right of the panel; title Gravity is a property of mass, with the myth line in red and NASA's statement.

slides.body: Seen from Spain, Iceland, Greenland and a corner of Portugal. Totality 16:58 to 18:34 UTC, up to 2 min 18 s. The hoax's 14:33 UTC was two hours before the eclipse even began. Real, spectacular, and not a gravity switch.
slides.alt: The eclipse at totality breaks the top left of the panel; title There was a total solar eclipse, with where and when it was seen.

slides.claim: How to spot the next one
slides.body: Exact date, exact time, huge dollar figure: be suspicious. Check the agency's own website for the document. Ask what law of physics would have to break.
slides.alt: A large eclipse disc breaks the top right of the panel; title How to spot the next one, three checks.

slides.body: Snopes fact check (rating False; NASA's statement by email). Newsweek, NASA's Karen Fox: the hoax 'comes around every year'. Yahoo, the Snopes fact check syndicated. NASA's statement, as reported by Geo.tv. Not a research paper: a dated hoax and its debunks, January and August 2026.
